description: Document structure for Proposal/CODEX-{slug}.md (engage-codex Step 5). Decision-focused — the recommended outline (or 'user choice'), the comparison table, and per-path critique findings are surfaced where a user can act on them.

sections.title: Story Brief
sections.description: Original user brief: premise, genre, length target, tone, protagonist want/need, central conflict, constraints.

sections.title: Paradigms Explored
sections.description: One row per path: paradigm name, artefact type, one-sentence rationale.

sections.title: Artefacts
sections.description: One section per path. Full structured artefact + ≤200-word rationale narrative.

sections.title: Synthesis Comparison Table
sections.description: The comparison table from Step 3. Recommended path called out if one emerged.

sections.title: Narrative Critique
sections.description: One section per path with findings per category (pacing valleys, unset-up payoffs, character-motivation gaps, unsupported tonal shifts). 'Clean' categories listed explicitly.

sections.title: What Would Change This Recommendation
sections.description: 2-3 bullets naming the constraint / paradigm assumption / story-brief detail that, if updated, would flip the recommended path.
